preconditions.description: The number of computers is between 1 and 1500.
The difficulty values are between 0 and the maximum possible value for a given n.
The difficulty between a computer and itself is 0.

preconditions.expression: a_{i,j} > 0 for all 1 <= i < j <= n
preconditions.description: The difficulty between any two different computers is greater than 0.

preconditions.expression: a_{i,j} = a_{j,i} for all 1 <= i < j <= n
all a_{i,j} for i < j are different
preconditions.description: All difficulties between different computers are unique.

postconditions.expression: output[k] is the number of ways to divide computers into k groups, modulo 998244353
postconditions.description: The output for each k should be the count of valid groupings modulo 998244353.
